text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this day, Admire Vega and Narita Top Road came to the studio together for a magazine photoshoot, but...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, your expression is still a bit stiff...
I'm sorry! Would it be alright if we call it for today
and reschedule for another time?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san!
Good work today.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
Even though you had your own photoshoot scheduled..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, no!
I've been stiff as a board from nervousness the whole time too, so I probably would've ended up the same way...!
choice_data_list: Shall we go somewhere for a change of pace?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!
In that case, I know just the place!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
This museum is having an "Astrophotography Exhibition" right now!
I was just thinking of letting you know about it, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I think it's perfect for a change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's so beautiful. Was this taken deep in the mountains...?
The air looks so clear, even though it's just a photo—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...There's real depth to it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That's it. It feels so vivid and real,
and just watching it feels so cleansing for the soul...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
That must have been how much they wanted to convey it...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The emotions these stars stirred in my heart... I want to share them with someone...
I'm flattered, but... it's a little embarrassing having you see right through me like that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see!
You're the one who took that photo, right?!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for calling out to you so suddenly.
I just never thought I'd find someone who felt... the same way I did about that scenery...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...That's just how good of a photo it was.
It's all thanks to your talent."

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it makes me happy that my feelings came through.
So, allow me to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Feelings...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(I was drawn to that, wasn't I...?
That's why it left such an impression—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Ah, I see... what's important for a photo is...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later on, Admire Vega had to participate in another photo shoot...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Looking good! That's much better!
Alright, one more photo coming up...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Just having my picture taken isn't enough...
I have to put... my feelings into it...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (In that case... what I need to pour into this is—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (To get stronger and keep running... that's my only desire.)

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thank you very much!
I think these will turn out to be great photos!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, you were so cool!!
I was completely blown away by that last part!
choice_data_list: Indeed, it's gotten so much better.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …………Not really.
choice_data_list: Looks like you could handle modeling work too.
Looks like you could handle modeling work too, huh?
I can't wait to see how it turns out!
I can't wait to see how it turns out!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …………Not really.
choice_data_list: Looks like you could handle modeling work too.
Looks like you could handle modeling work too, huh?
I can't wait to see how it turns out!
I can't wait to see how it turns out!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That's a completely different story, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "I don't think that's true at all! You'd make a wonderful model, Ayabe-san!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: N. O. P. E.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right! I want everyone to see it, too.
...Should we hand them out or something?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You really don't have to do that...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
…………
I'd like to let things like that take their natural course.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I see... Understood!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
True, that does sound
much more like you, Ayabe-san!
